subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The new game was not what everyone expected, but the gym was full of shouting and laughter.”?
options: At the end, the teacher said, "Rain changes plans, not fun."
Their teacher said it was a simple lesson: when things look the same on the outside, names can save lunch.
Sometimes usefulness changes with time, but it does not always disappear.
Technology changes objects, but human behavior remains part of every system.
